items.action: Amendment SA 2223 agreed to in Senate by Unanimous Consent.
items.label: S.Amdt. 2223
items.purpose: To modify the period for exercise of authority for the sale by the Department of Defense of aircraft and parts for wildfire suppression purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies and commercial entities involved in wildfire suppression.
dimensions.evidence: reauthorizes the Department of Defense to sell its excess aircraft and aircraft parts that are acceptable for commercial sale for wildfire suppression purposes

dimensions.assessment: Expands allowable uses to include water delivery and international assistance, providing moderate operational changes.
dimensions.evidence: the previous authority only provided for the delivery of fire retardant

dimensions.assessment: Involves the sale of excess government property over a ten-year period without explicit spending levels stated.
Amends existing statutory authority regarding excess military aircraft transfers.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Wildfire Suppression Aircraft Transfer Act of 1996 to reauthorize the sale by the Department of Defense of aircraft and parts

dimensions.assessment: Extends authority from June 12, 2025, until October 1, 2035.
dimensions.evidence: Such authority begins June 12, 2025, and ends October 1, 2035.

missing_information: Exact fiscal costs or projected revenues from aircraft sales.
Number of aircraft available for transfer.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill extends and modifies the Department of Defense's authority to sell excess aircraft and parts for wildfire suppression, adding water delivery and international reach.

latest_action.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Forestry and Horticulture.
